description: This PHP source file implements a web page for an administrative password change feature within a web interface. It includes security measures like CSRF protection, session validation, and client-side validation scripts for password input fields. The page is styled with CSS and includes JavaScript to handle form submission, password visibility toggling, and user interaction.
